source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT       [ID]       ,[CM_MEM_NAME]       ,[CM_MEM_ID]       ,[CM_DOS_BEGIN]       ,[CM_DOS_END]       ,[CM_ACCT_NUM]       ,[CM_TOT_AMT_CHARGE]       ,[CM_TOT_AMT_PAID]       ,[CM_CLAIM_ID]       ,[CM_LINE_NUM]       ,[CM_PROVIDER_ID]       ,[CM_PROVIDER_TIN]       ,[CM_SUBSCHEME]       ,[CM_AFFNUM_ID]       ,[SRC_SYS_CD]       ,[CM_COM_DB_EXP]       ,[CM_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[CM_IMR_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[CM_2MR_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[CM_FMR_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[CM_OPL_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[CM_OPL_FINAL_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[On Hold not Sent IMR]       ,[On Hold Date]       ,[On Hold Reason]       ,[On Hold Notes]       ,[ADJUSTED]       ,[PRODUCT]       ,[APPEAL_RECEIPT_DATE]       ,[APPEAL_RESULT]       ,[APPEAL_RESULT_REASON]       ,[APPEAL_RESULT_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[APPEAL2_RECEIPT_DATE]       ,[APPEAL2_RESULT]       ,[APPEAL2_RESULT_REASON]       ,[APPEAL2_RESULT_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[APPEALED3_RECEIPT_DATE]       ,[APPEAL3_RESULT]       ,[APPEAL3_RESULT_REASON]       ,[APPEAL3_RESULT_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[SENT_TO_VENDOR]       ,[APPEAL_NOTIFY_DT2]       ,[APPEAL_NOTIFY_DT3]       ,[INVOICE_RECEIPT_DATE]       ,[INVOICE_FROM]       ,[INVOICE_AMOUNT]       ,[MARKET]       ,[PAID_DT]       ,[RECEIVED_DT]       ,[FEE_SCH_RATE]       ,[FEE_SCHEDULE]       ,[UNIT_CONVERSION]       ,[PAID_UNITS]       ,[RECORD_TYPE]       ,[DUPLICATE_IND]       ,[MODIFIED_DATE]       ,[LOGICAL_DELETE_IND]       ,[CM_MEM_DOB]       ,[CM_TD_NOTIFY_DT]       ,[CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG]   FROM [OPS].[linked_CLAIM_MEMBER]   WHERE  	MODIFIED_DATE >= ?  ORDER BY ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CVILinkedCLAIMMEMBER	source(output(
		{} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT         [ID]       ,[MR_CLAIM_ID]       ,[MR_PROVIDER_ID]       ,[MR_PROVIDER_TIN]       ,[MR_AFFNUM_ID]       ,[MR_MEM_ID]       ,[MR_DATE]       ,[MR_REVIEW_COMPLETE]       ,[MR_REVIEW_DT]       ,[MR_OVP]       ,[Supported or Unsupported]       ,[CPT Billed]       ,[CPT Allowed]       ,[MR_MARKET]       ,[Sent to MCR]       ,[MR_SUBSCHEME]       ,[MR_PROC_CODES]       ,[SRC_SYS_CD]       ,[CLAIM_LINE]       ,[PROVIDERS]       ,[MODIFIED_DATE]       ,[LOGICAL_DELETE_IND]   FROM                [OPS].[linked_MEDICAL_RECORD_RECEIPT] WHERE  1 = 1          AND MODIFIED_DATE >= ? ORDER BY ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CVILinkedMEDICALRECORDRECEIPT	source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT         [ID]       ,[STATUS]       ,[CLAIM_ID]       ,[ORIGIN]       ,[IMPORT_DATE]       ,[DELETE_INDICATOR]       ,[MODIFIED_DATE]       ,[LOGICAL_DELETE_IND]   FROM  	[OPS].[linked_MR_RECEIPT_LOG] WHERE            MODIFIED_DATE >= ? ORDER BY ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CVILinkedMRRECEIPTLOG	source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: ';WITH ExpireDateCte AS ( 	SELECT DISTINCT LB.CM_CLAIM_ID, LB.EXPIRE_DT FROM [TRK].[STG_CLAIM_ITERATION] SC  	JOIN OPS.vwLKBACK LB ON LB.CM_CLAIM_ID = SC.CLCL_ID  ) SELECT distinct 	SC.CLCL_ID, MR.ID MR_ID, MR.MR_DATE, MR.MR_MARKET, CM.ID CM_ID, CM.CM_ACCT_NUM, CM.CM_TD_NOTIFY_FLG, CM.APPEAL_RECEIPT_DATE, CM.APPEAL2_RECEIPT_DATE,  	CM.CM_IMR_NOTIFY_DT, CAST(CT.EXPIRE_DT AS DATETIME) EXPIRE_DT, GETDATE() AS addDate FROM [TRK].[STG_CLAIM_ITERATION] SC 	LEFT JOIN [OPS].[linked_CLAIM_MEMBER] CM ON CM.CM_CLAIM_ID = SC.CLCL_ID 		AND LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = \'N\' 	LEFT JOIN OPS.PBI_DIM_ANALYTIC_PROJECT_LOOKUP LP ON LP.SC_SUBSCHEME = CM.CM_SUBSCHEME 	LEFT JOIN ExpireDateCte CT ON CT.CM_CLAIM_ID = SC.CLCL_ID 	LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(MODIFIED_DATE) MODIFIED_DATE, MR_CLAIM_ID  				FROM [OPS].[linked_MEDICAL_RECORD_RECEIPT]  				WHERE LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = \'N\'  				GROUP BY MR_CLAIM_ID) MAX_MD_DT ON  MAX_MD_DT.MR_CLAIM_ID = SC.CLCL_ID 	LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(MR_DATE) MR_DATE, MR_CLAIM_ID  				FROM [OPS].[linked_MEDICAL_RECORD_RECEIPT]  				WHERE LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = \'N\'  				GROUP BY MR_CLAIM_ID) MAX_MR_DT ON  MAX_MR_DT.MR_CLAIM_ID = SC.CLCL_ID 	LEFT JOIN [OPS].[linked_MEDICAL_RECORD_RECEIPT] MR ON MR.MR_CLAIM_ID = SC.CLCL_ID 		AND MR.MODIFIED_DATE = MAX_MD_DT.MODIFIED_DATE 		AND MR.MR_DATE = MAX_MR_DT.MR_DATE 		AND MR.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = \'N\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CVIWSSourceQuery	source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [CVI_ID]       ,[PR_TIN]       ,[PR_PROVIDER]       ,[PR_SPEC1]       ,[PR_ADDR1]       ,[PR_ADDR2]       ,[PR_CITY]       ,[PR_STATE]       ,[PR_ZIP]       ,[PR_PHONE1]       ,[PR_PHONE2]       ,[PR_FAX1]       ,[PR_FAX2]       ,[PR_EMAIL]       ,[PR_AFFNUM]       ,[PR_SPEC2]       ,[PR_SPEC3]       ,[PR_FLAGEFFDATE]       ,[PR_FLAGENDDATE]       ,[PR_PROVLAST]       ,[PR_PROVFIRST]       ,[PR_DEGREE]       ,[PR_NPI]       ,[PR_SOURCE]       ,[CONTACT_LEVEL]       ,[CID Case]       ,[SEND_TO]       ,[PROV_ID]       ,[UPDATE_ADDRESS]       ,[PREFERRED_ADDR1]       ,[PREFERRED_ADDR2]       ,[PREFERRED_CITY]       ,[PREFERRED_STATE]       ,[PREFERRED_ZIP]       ,[PREFERRED_ADDR_SEND_TO]       ,[PRACTITIONER_ID]       ,[PROVIDER_TYPE_CD]       ,[MODIFIED_DATE]       ,[LOGICAL_DELETE_IND]       ,[LGROUP_CD]       ,[VERCOL]       ,[Analytic_Review_Type_CD]       ,[TRACKER_UPDATE_ON]       ,[TRACKER_UPDATE_BY]       ,[CLAIM_MEMBER_UPDATED]   FROM [OPS].[linked_PROVIDERFILE]   WHERE  1 = 1               AND MODIFIED_DATE >= ?  ORDER BY [CVI_ID]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CVIWSLinkedPROVIDERFILE	source(output(

	),
